full_prompt_en: A young woman sits in profile on a pale stone ledge, facing right and resting her chin lightly on one hand. A broad cream-colored feathered wing extends from behind her shoulder toward the left edge. Her copper hair is gathered into a soft roll, and an orange-rust bodice contrasts with the muted grey-green folds of her long skirt. A woven basket rests beside her, its rough geometric weave and a few small warm flowers adding a tactile accent near the lower left. She looks toward a flight of small pale birds that cross a deep teal sky dotted with rounded grey clouds. The figure fills most of the square composition, yet her upward gaze opens a generous pocket of dark atmosphere to the right. Her skin is luminous and carefully modeled; fabric, feathers, stone, and wicker each hold distinct fine textures. The painting combines precise contours at the face and fingers with softer transitions in clouds and distant space. Warm rose, copper, and ocher tones are set against blue-green shadow, creating a gentle tension between intimacy and open air. Highlights catch the wing, cheek, and bird forms without becoming harsh. Decorative detail enriches the image but remains subordinate to the quiet pose and the directional movement of the gaze. The mood is contemplative and dreamlike, with an almost storybook clarity carried by layered, finely worked paint.
full_prompt_zh: 一位年轻女子侧身坐在浅色石沿上，面向右方，轻轻用一只手托着下巴。一片宽大的乳白色羽翼从她肩后向画面左缘展开。铜色头发盘成柔软的发髻，橙锈色上衣与灰绿色长裙的褶皱形成对照。身旁放着一只编织篮，粗糙的几何编纹和几朵暖色小花在左下角增添可触摸的细节。她望向一群浅色小鸟，它们飞过布满圆润灰云的深青绿色天空。人物占据方形构图的大部分空间，但向上的视线在右侧打开一片宽裕的暗色空气。肌肤明亮且塑造细致；布料、羽毛、石头和柳编各自保有鲜明而细密的纹理。画面在面部和手指处使用准确轮廓，在云层和远处空间则转为柔和过渡。温暖的玫瑰色、铜色与赭色置于蓝绿色阴影之中，在亲近感和开阔空气之间形成轻柔张力。亮部落在羽翼、脸颊和飞鸟上，却不显刺眼。装饰性细节丰富了图像，仍然服从于安静的姿态和视线的方向。氛围沉思而如梦，层层细作的颜料带出近似故事插画的清晰感。
style_prompt_en: Finely layered paint joins luminous, carefully modeled pale forms with deep blue-green atmospheric shadow. Warm copper, russet, rose, and ocher accents sit against a cool teal ground. Contours are precise at focal edges and soften into clouded or distant passages. Distinct surfaces receive patient microtexture: fine parallel lines, featherlike striations, woven geometry, and worn stone grain, balanced by broad velvety dark areas. Rounded decorative forms and gently flowing diagonals create a lyrical rhythm. Small highlights are selectively placed so the composition glows without hard glare. The overall mood is intimate, contemplative, and dreamlike, with detailed craft anchored by generous dark breathing space.
style_prompt_zh: 细密叠加的颜料把明亮、精心塑造的浅色形体与深蓝绿色的大气阴影连接起来。温暖的铜色、锈红、玫瑰色和赭黄点缀在冷青绿色底色上。焦点边缘轮廓准确，云雾或远处区域则逐渐柔化。不同表面经过耐心刻画，呈现细平行线、羽状纹理、编织几何和旧石颗粒，同时由宽阔如天鹅绒般的暗部平衡。圆润的装饰形和缓缓流动的对角线构成抒情节奏。小块高光经过选择性安排，使构图发亮而没有刺眼眩光。整体气氛亲近、沉思且如梦，细致工艺由充足的深色留空稳稳托住。
theme_en: A winged young woman pausing beside a dark, bird-filled sky
theme_zh: 一位有羽翼的年轻女子在飞鸟掠过的暗色天空旁沉思
name: Annie Swynnerton
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
